metadata.purpose: Protect the default branch and keep history reviewable, linear, and recoverable.
recommended_workflow: Create short-lived feature branches from main.
Commit small, focused changes with imperative commit messages.
Open pull requests for changes to main.
Keep pull requests focused and resolve review threads before merge.
Prefer squash or rebase merges to preserve linear history.
Pull with rebase before pushing local branches.
Never force-push shared branches unless coordinated and necessary.
Do not commit secrets, build artifacts, or local environment files.
notes: Add required status check names after CI is configured.
Signed commits require each contributor to configure commit signing.
GitHub rulesets must be imported or recreated in the GitHub repository settings to take effect.
